convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load SilverTrend_Signal custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position sizing, open/close logic, and margin mode enumeration. Custom indicator is not a built-in MT5 indicator.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timestamp alignment
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator to be valid

other_exits: When both buy-open and buy-close (or sell-open and sell-close) are enabled and no immediate close signal is found on SignalBar, the EA scans historical bars forward from SignalBar+1 to find the earliest opposing signal to mark close=true, acting as a retroactive close trigger

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input (0.1) is interpreted as either lot size or percentage fraction depending on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a retroactive close-signal scan: if both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose (or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose) are enabled and the current SignalBar does not produce a close signal, it scans forward through historical bars (bar=SignalBar+1 to end) looking for the first opposing signal to set the close flag. This means the close trigger can come from a signal on a bar older than SignalBar. The SignalBar input defaults to 1 (previous completed bar), so entries are based on the last closed bar's signal, not the forming bar. Entry/exit logic is delegated entirely to TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose). A static Recount flag triggers re-evaluation if CopyBuffer fails. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: SilverTrend_Signal is a custom indicator not available in standard Python libraries - its algorithm must be reverse-engineered or sourced separately. The SSP (9) and RISK (3) parameters control signal generation. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides all position open/close and money management logic - this must be reimplemented in Python including the 5 MarginMode variants. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) which likely need 5-digit adjustment (divide by 10 for pips). The new-bar guard using CIsNewBar class must be replicated. The retroactive close-signal scan is unusual and must be carefully preserved. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are passed to open functions suggesting pending or time-gated execution.
